eva_support: Customer ACME reporting invoice shows ~12k tokens but dashboard shows ~6.3k for last 24h. Customer insists they only sent ~30 requests. Can we triage? customer_id=acme-prod-47

omar_engineer: ok sending steps. do we have request ids or sample request? any client sdk?

eva_support: They pasted one sample request body and headers. Notably: `Authorization: Bearer <redacted>` and `X-Idempotency-Key:` is missing in some entries. They said mobile SDK v0.9.3, intermittent network.

infra-bot: gateway: retried request rpc_id=rdw-req-99321 attempts=3 reason="upstream timeout" route=public-gw-2
infra-bot: metering: emit_event request_id=rdw-req-99321 tokens=410 status=charged

omar_engineer: that log looks like a replay: gateway retried and each retry produced a separate metering event because idempotency header absent. do we see any dedupe on ledger side?

maria_billing: ledger shows three separate records for acme-prod-47 for 2026-03-16T12:06:xx, each ~410 tokens. Dashboard aggregates by request_id when present; otherwise it sums raw events — which explains dashboard undercount if some events were filtered? odd.

sam_oncall: quick questions: 1) did the proxy strip `X-Idempotency-Key` on retry? 2) is client re-sending a new request id per reconnect?

eva_support: customer says mobile client had a flaky conn. They see the SDK requeue on network change. They don't set idempotency header themselves.

omar_engineer: can we search proxy logs around rdw-req-99321 for header mutation? grep snippet: ```
[2026-03-16T12:05:34Z] proxy@gw-2 incoming req rpc_id=rdw-req-99321 headers={authorization, content-type}
[2026-03-16T12:05:36Z] proxy@gw-2 retrying req rpc_id=rdw-req-99321 retry=1 outgoing headers={authorization, x-forwarded-for}
[2026-03-16T12:05:36Z] proxy@gw-2 emit-metering event_id=evt-7762 tokens=410
[2026-03-16T12:05:39Z] proxy@gw-2 retrying req rpc_id=rdw-req-99321 retry=2 outgoing headers={authorization}
[2026-03-16T12:05:39Z] proxy@gw-2 emit-metering event_id=evt-7764 tokens=410
```

omar_engineer: takeaway: header set changed between attempts (idemp header absent). our metering currently charges per emitted event; dedupe requires consistent `Idempotency-Key` or same `request_id` in body.

maria_billing: so invoice shows 3x charge, dashboard shows only 1x because our dashboard pipeline deduped by `client_request_id` field when SDK populates it. ACME's mobile SDK didn't set that for retries -> mismatch. we should refund the duplicate two events.

sam_oncall: agree. action items: 1) refund duplicates for acme-prod-47 (maria) 2) patch gateway to preserve `X-Idempotency-Key` on retries (omar/infra) 3) update docs + SDK quickfix to always set idempotency for mobile reconnects (devex) 4) run a quick search for other customers with >2 identical events in 60s window and alert (sam).

omar_engineer: small mitigation: add a soft dedupe at metering stage keyed by `Authorization` + `client_ip` + `payload_hash` within 10s window for mobile patterns. Not perfect but reduces noise. will make PR. :hammer:

maria_billing: I'll prepare the refund (estimate ~820 tokens x2 => 1640 tokens credit) and CC finance.

eva_support: pinged ACME with ETA and asked for SDK logs; they provided client logs showing reconnect + SDK requeue. they will validate once refund completes. :white_check_mark:

sam_oncall: logging note: add a diagnostic tag when gateway retries emit metering so support can quickly correlate. low-friction.

omar_engineer: filing internal bug: GH-9876 preserve-idempotency-on-retry. also PR for soft-dedupe GH-9877.

eva_support: thanks team. closing once refund processed and ACME confirms. :pray:
